label: Money & Independence
notes: Money & Independence: gameId money-independence matches registry (export MoneyIndependenceGame). Reworks ModesEngine build onto v2 engine. 84 scenarios faithfully mapped from GDD 48 JSON: 6 cats (budget-it/save-and-traps/earn-and-ask/money-and-love/money-is-freedom/tools-and-help), 7 types (branch 20/sort 16/strike-rewrite 15/reflect 12/match 8/role-play 8/spot 5), 0% binary. Money = independence/safety/choices: budget it (light sim), save & avoid traps (debt/EMIs/BNPL/scams), earn & ask (payslips/pay gap/negotiating), money & love (fair money; FINANCIAL CONTROL as abuse under DV Act -> 181/1091), money is freedom. EDUCATIONAL not financial advice; no products promoted; no real data collected. India: UPI/EMIs/payslips/pay gap (reassureCats money-and-love+money-is-freedom). binStyle: added \btrap\b->red (covers Debt trap/Trap; all 'trap' labels are bad-side incl firewall/life-ready 'A trap') + sensible->green (g48-only); categorisation bins (Need/Want, Fixed/Flexible, Raises it/Doesn't, Toward freedom/Away, Normal/Control, Protects/Erodes) left neutral by design. Spot ids injected (5). Builds on g42; pairs g49/g52; continues into g58.
